europe_now.title: Curfews Imposed Across Parts of France Following Days of Unrest
europe_now.summary: Authorities in France have implemented localized curfews and instructed online marketplaces to crack down on the resale of looted goods following a weekend marked by widespread civil violence.

sources.headline: Live: Curfews come into effect around France to combat looting
France tells online marketplaces to crack down on resale of looted items

europe_now.title: Fatal Flooding Impacts Eastern Spain Amid Severe Weather
europe_now.summary: Torrential rain has inundated eastern regions of Spain, resulting in four fatalities and prompting widespread concern as the country heads toward a snap election.

sources.headline: Spain floods kill four as torrential rain inundates eastern regions

top_stories.title: Civil Unrest and Security Measures in France
top_stories.summary: France has introduced localized curfews to combat widespread looting and violence following a turbulent protest weekend. The government has also directed online platforms to prevent the sale of stolen property.

top_stories.title: Severe Weather and Fatal Floods in Spain
top_stories.summary: Torrential downpours across eastern Spain have claimed four lives as floodwaters inundated local areas. The weather emergency unfolds alongside complex political developments ahead of upcoming elections.
